context: Split the tuple into directory prefixes (trailing slash, matched with startswith) and exact files (matched with ==). Keep one public predicate. Extend the parametrized auto-mergeable list with the .bak/.example shapes so the distinction is pinned, and keep the 1:1 CODEOWNERS test passing.
description: Codex P2 on PR #1529 (merged). is_soundness_path() passes the whole SOUNDNESS_PREFIXES tuple to str.startswith(), so entries documented and tested as EXACT FILES also match anything sharing that prefix: benchbox/core/results/anonymization.py.bak and benchbox/core/results/anonymization_specs.yaml.example are treated as review-required, while the corresponding CODEOWNERS patterns are exact and do not match them. That silently breaks the 1:1 gate/CODEOWNERS contract asserted by test_codeowners_matches_soundness_prefixes_1to1 and needlessly withholds auto-merge. Pre-existing for the other exact-file entries too (result_capture.py, resolver.py, decision.py, _registration.py, and the two workflow files); #1529 added two more instances rather than introducing the flaw. Note the existing test pins that result_capture_helpers.py does NOT match, which holds only because that name diverges before the extension - it does not cover the .bak/.example shape.

verifications.expected: Extend the auto-mergeable parametrization in w1

work_units.summary: Separate exact-file matching from directory-prefix matching
